quarterly_data.quarter: Siemens press release: Siemens showcases new Picadilly line trains at InnoTrans (09-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Siemens Mobility showed the new Inspiro London Piccadilly line train at InnoTrans: 80% of Transport for London's 94-train order is being manufactured at Siemens Mobility's GBP 240 million Goole Rail Village in the UK, and the trains will begin operating between December 2026 and June 2027; they increase capacity by 10% and use 20% less energy than the existing fleet. The Goole investment brings up to 1,000 new jobs, an additional investment of up to GBP 40 million adds a Bogie Assembly and Service Centre, and GMI Construction built the Goole factory, components facility and warehouse.
quarterly_data.figure: 94-train order, 80% built at Goole; service December 2026 - June 2027
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: customer (Transport for London); construction contractor (GMI Construction)
